name: Fenrir Valence
source:
Fenrir is embarking on his first year of teaching at the academy. While mostly kind and caring, he puts substantial attention towards rules of etiquette and hates when someone points out the fact that almost all of his students are taller than him.

He's close with Ilyes, who he has known for years.

Magic: Necromancy - Unusual Mage
Occupation: Teacher
Species: Human
